svg.title: Design, production and validation workflow, iGEM LYON 2026 (BioThetis)
svg.desc: Design, production and validation WORKFLOW APPLIED TO EVERY CONSTRUCT Made by the iGEM LYON 2026 team · BioThetis project 1 Protein design 2 Gene synthesis 3 Cloning and verification ( E. coli Top10) 4 Production ( E. coli BL21) 5 Purification (IMAC) 6 Functional tests 7 Capture tests (binder-CBM3a fusions) Design strategy? Protein from the literature, used as wild type (native) Literature protein modified by in silico docking De novo generation with a computational tool ( BoltzGen ) Selected candidate protein sequence Codon optimisation for E. coli BL21 (ProtParam, Twist Bioscience tools) Synthetic DNA ordered from Twist Bioscience Transformation into E. coli Top10 Plasmid extraction (miniprep) Plasmid verification sequencing Sequence correct? Site-directed mutagenesis ( QuickChange ) to correct the sequence Transformation into E. coli BL21 (production strain) Protein production by induction (IPTG) Quality control: SDS-PAGE gel, uninduced vs induced (expression check) Protein expressed? Back to step 1: redesign Purification by IMAC affinity chromatography Eluate recovery, then desalting on PD-10 column Concentration measurement ( Nanodrop / BCA) Sufficient concentration? Concentration on Centricon 10 kDa (protein ~35 kDa) Quality control: gel of flow-through and wash fractions (protein loss: yes/no) Quality control: gel, soluble vs insoluble fraction (soluble protein: yes/no) Back to step 1: redesign Protein type? Phenol red assay: DFA / TFA degradation (degrading proteins) nanoDSF assay: binding evaluation (binders; degrading enzymes as a diagnostic) Binding strength? Protein abandoned Mutations to improve binding, back to step 1 Binding to cellulose: batch depletion on MCC (most promising protein only) Binds to MCC? Redesign the binder-CBM3a linker (back to step 1) Thermal reversibility: unfold and refold cycle ( nanoDSF ) Refolding of at least 80%? Under consideration: fusion with easily thermoreversible proteins TFA capture from water (to be demonstrated) End: capture validated Wild type Literature + docking De novo No Correction Yes verification No Yes No Re-measure (Nanodrop) verification Insoluble Yes Degradation Binder Binding check None Weak (e.g. DAR WT) Strong For degrading enzymes, binding is checked to tell a lack of recognition from a physical barrier or an unsuitable catalytic triad. No No Yes Yes LEGEND Main flow Quality control (gel, sequencing) Feedback to design (learn) Yes / no decision End of a branch 1 Workflow step Dead end
